request.style: English, heavy metal, distorted down-tuned guitars, galloping riffs, double kick drums, a powerful clean male vocal with a gritty edge, choir pads in the chorus, epic and dark, minor key, 150 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Lamb has opened the first seal
A voice like thunder cries out, come
A white horse rides, its rider holds a bow
He goes out conquering, a crown upon his head

[Verse]
The second seal, a fiery red horse
Its rider takes the peace from the earth
A great sword in his hand
And people turn on one another

[Chorus]
Come, cries the thunder
The horsemen ride
Who can stand before the Lamb
When the seals are opened wide

[Verse]
The third seal, a black horse
A pair of scales in its rider's hand
The fourth, a pale horse, its rider is Death
And Hades follows close behind

[Chorus]
Come, cries the thunder
The horsemen ride
Who can stand before the Lamb
When the seals are opened wide
